concepts.name: session
concepts.definition: One supervised agent process (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code, Grok or a custom CLI) that glimmervoid spawns in a PTY, keyed by a stable UUID and shown on the dashboard

concepts.name: worktree
concepts.definition: The git worktree glimmervoid creates for one session from the integration branch, so concurrent sessions never share a working tree

concepts.name: lane
concepts.definition: A background job glimmervoid runs beside operator sessions on its own schedule (team review, Radar, benchmarks, usage), built as a pure core, an IO-free poller and a thin wiring shell

concepts.name: view
concepts.definition: A primary dashboard surface the operator switches between (Focus, Settings, Trace, Issues, Usage and the lane tabs, plus Boards on the phone), or one session's rendering inside it, its face (Terminal, Plan or the Board pane in Focus)

concepts.name: team
concepts.definition: The operator's GitHub team, whose open pull requests the team review lane reviews and lists in Reviews, Team

concepts.name: attention
concepts.definition: Which sessions need the operator now, ranked from their status, and the surfaces that show it (the Board attention row, the rail readout, notifications)

concepts.name: waiting
concepts.definition: The session status meaning the agent stopped and needs the operator, derived from hook events or the OSC-0 title

concepts.name: guardrails
concepts.definition: Sane YOLO, the Safety Net hooks that refuse risky commands and credential reads in sessions and lanes; accident protection, never a sandbox

concepts.name: operator
concepts.definition: The one carbon unit who runs glimmervoid and its dashboard and answers its sessions

concepts.name: agent adapter
concepts.definition: The per-agent module (first-class: Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code; best effort: Grok, custom CLI) that tells glimmervoid how to spawn, resume and read the status of one agent kind

concepts.name: visions
concepts.definition: The retired editor lane that commented on documents open in the VS Code extension; it survives only in the changelog's history

concepts.name: radar
concepts.definition: The PostHog auto-fix lane that investigates PostHog errors in a session and writes an HTML report

concepts.name: operator config
concepts.definition: Glimmervoid's own settings file, config.json under the operator's glimmervoid home, whose shape is the config schema in shared/contracts/config.ts

concepts.name: monitoring
concepts.definition: The status the dashboard shows for a working session whose turn has ended while its background tasks or sub-agents are still running

concepts.name: starting
concepts.definition: The status the dashboard shows while a session sets up its worktree and boots its agent, until the agent's first turn begins

concepts.name: failed
concepts.definition: A session state: the agent process exited with an error, so the session needs the operator to restart or close it before it can continue.

concepts.name: zen
concepts.definition: A retired experimental dashboard view that showed each live session as a pet in a meadow and staged one session needing the operator at a time; past release notes still name it.

concepts.name: worth a look
concepts.definition: The review panel's short list of change signals an operator can act on: a file another session is changing, a package link into another repository, or a usual partner file left out.

concepts.name: committed
concepts.definition: Changes a session has recorded in commits on its branch, as opposed to edits still only in its worktree.

concepts.name: pairing
concepts.definition: Granting a device access to the remote listener with a single-use link from glimmervoid pair; a paired device has full control as the operator.

concepts.name: experimental
concepts.definition: A Glimmervoid build published from a green push to main as X.Y.Z-next.N under the npm next tag, and the settings that run only on such a build

concepts.name: channel
concepts.definition: The update stream an install follows: release (npm latest) or experimental (the newer of npm next and latest)

concepts.name: copy
concepts.definition: Text an agent or the operator puts on the browser clipboard from a terminal, offered through the Copy to clipboard prompt when the browser blocks the agent's own write.

concepts.name: rescan
concepts.definition: The first-run checklist action that looks again for installed agents and repository roots without a restart.

concepts.name: skip
concepts.definition: An operator choice to pass over a step Glimmervoid would otherwise take, as in skipping permission prompts or the skip-to-main link.

concepts.name: kimi code
concepts.definition: Moonshot's Kimi Code CLI, one of the agent CLIs glimmervoid supervises through its kimi agent adapter

concepts.name: question
concepts.definition: An agent's request for the operator's answer (Claude Code AskUserQuestion, Codex request_user_input, Kimi Code AskUserQuestion), carried as the question kind of a session's ConversationApproval and putting the session in waiting until answered

concepts.name: community question
concepts.definition: A question a member of the public asked on a watched community source (posthog.com/questions or an allowlisted Discord channel) that the Community tab tracks, researches and drafts a reply for, which the operator posts by hand.

concepts.name: discord
concepts.definition: A community source: the PostHog Discord server, read through the Discord events PostHog already captures, limited to the channel names the operator allowlists.

concepts.name: community
concepts.definition: The experimental lane and dashboard tab that watches community sources for new community questions and drafts researched answers the operator posts by hand

concepts.name: connect
concepts.definition: Link a session to a whiteboard so it is told what others changed on the board; the connection lives on the board record

concepts.name: running
concepts.definition: The session status meaning the agent is mid-turn and working, derived from hook events or the OSC-0 title; the Issues step for an issue with a live session

concepts.name: boards
concepts.definition: A shared whiteboard of boxes, wires, frames, notes and plan units that sessions and the operator draw together, opened in a Board pane beside a session's terminal in Focus and listed in the Boards section

concepts.name: pull request
concepts.definition: A GitHub pull request a session is linked to, shown on its card and in Reviews

concepts.name: trust
concepts.definition: An agent CLI's own record that a folder may run its project config and tools without asking, such as Kimi Code's Trust this folder? dialog, which Glimmervoid pre-grants for the sessions it spawns

concepts.name: verdict
concepts.definition: A community research run's confidence in its draft (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW or FAILED); only a finished HIGH run with a draft notifies

concepts.name: docs
concepts.definition: Text files a session hands the operator with glimmervoid edit to read, edit and save back in the doc editor; its Docs button is hidden from the session header until the feature is ready

concepts.name: streamer mode
concepts.definition: A dashboard setting that hides sensitive details (secrets, titles, avatars, settings) while the operator screen shares; switched in Settings or by its keyboard shortcut

concepts.name: markup
concepts.definition: The doc editor's red pen mode, which shows a doc's CriticMarkup edits as teacher-style marks the operator accepts, rejects or adds to

concepts.name: dismiss
concepts.definition: Close a review item on the operator's own pull request with a typed reason, posted as a reply on each of its threads before they are resolved; also clear a session's status as seen (user_dismiss), which takes Complete to Idle and Waiting back to Running

concepts.name: handled
concepts.definition: The list on one of the operator's own pull requests of review items already dismissed or sent to a session, by hand or by a rule, each with Undo

concepts.name: undo
concepts.definition: The Handled list control that reopens a review item, unresolving its thread on GitHub, and keeps rules from acting on it again

concepts.name: fix
concepts.definition: A change that corrects an operator-visible defect, landed as a fix-type commit with a CHANGELOG entry

concepts.name: secretive
concepts.definition: Secretive, a macOS app that keeps SSH keys in the Secure Enclave and serves them through its own agent socket, one of the agent app sockets the commit signer tries

concepts.name: pack
concepts.definition: A folder with a pack.json that adds PR flows, color themes or sandboxed HTML panels to Glimmervoid once the operator approves it in Settings, Packs

concepts.name: question manager
concepts.definition: The rule-driven answerer that replies to a session's question from the operator's questionManager rules and passes every other question to the operator as a waiting question

concepts.name: gemini cli
concepts.definition: Google's Gemini CLI, an agent CLI glimmervoid supervises through its gemini agent adapter, with hook status from a generated GEMINI_CLI_HOME

concepts.name: qwen code
concepts.definition: Alibaba's Qwen Code CLI, an agent CLI glimmervoid supervises through its qwen agent adapter, with hook status from a generated QWEN_HOME

concepts.name: copilot cli
concepts.definition: GitHub's Copilot CLI, an agent CLI glimmervoid supervises through its copilot agent adapter, with hook status from a generated COPILOT_HOME

concepts.name: queued
concepts.definition: The Reviews group for a team review waiting its turn for the review lane, before an agent starts on it

concepts.name: parked
concepts.definition: The Reviews group for a pull request set aside with no action left: a discarded team review or one of the operator's own drafts, collapsed by default

concepts.name: host
concepts.definition: A machine running Glimmervoid; a registered host is another such machine, listed under hosts in config, that this dashboard links over an ssh tunnel and shows in the sidebar with its sessions

concepts.name: watcher
concepts.definition: The always-on glimmervoid watch process that runs no sessions or dashboard and delivers jobs to a Glimmervoid server's job inbox; auto-started by the server on one machine, or run on its own box for Glimmervoid Cloud

concepts.name: job inbox
concepts.definition: The bearer-token listener inside a Glimmervoid server that accepts watcher jobs, parses each against its registered kind and acks it once

concepts.name: server
concepts.definition: The Glimmervoid Node.js background process on the operator's machine that supervises sessions, serves the dashboard and hosts the job inbox

concepts.name: watchee
concepts.definition: One lane's watching half on the watcher: detects external events on its trigger and delivers a job of its own kind, which a paired server handler acts on

concepts.name: reviewing now
concepts.definition: The Reviews column holding the Your turn pull requests the operator pulled in to work on, capped by the Reviewing now limit; the rest of Your turn shows as Ready

concepts.name: card
concepts.definition: A session's tile on the dashboard: its terminal with the header, status and Session actions menu, which Focus centers and the phone borrows; also a Reviews item or a whiteboard media box shown the same way

concepts.name: prompt
concepts.definition: The operator's message that starts an agent turn in a session, and the agent's request for input or permission (a permission prompt) that ends one

concepts.name: turn
concepts.definition: One agent work cycle in a session, from the prompt that starts it to the stop that ends it; Your turn is also the Reviews group of items waiting on the operator

concepts.name: settings
concepts.definition: The dashboard's Settings view, whose sections (Hosts, Appearance, Sane YOLO, Packs, Lane GitHub access and others) edit the operator config

concepts.name: focus
concepts.definition: The desktop Focus view: a left roster rail with one pill per session grouped by project, and one large center holding the selected session's terminal and Board panes; the phone Board is labelled Focus

concepts.name: layout
concepts.definition: One of the dashboard's two first-class shells, desktop or phone, chosen by decideLayout from pointer and viewport; also the arrangement of Focus panes and a board's laid-out geometry

concepts.name: control
concepts.definition: The control WebSocket (/control), the JSON channel between the server and every dashboard that carries session, board and review messages, beside the data WebSocket of raw PTY bytes; its handlers form the server's control plane

concepts.name: home
concepts.definition: A folder that holds an agent's or Glimmervoid's own state: the glimmervoid home (~/.glimmervoid), the per-agent homes Glimmervoid generates under its agent-homes folder (a Kimi Code, Codex, Gemini, Qwen or Copilot home), or the watcher home

concepts.name: action
concepts.definition: An operator command offered on a thing in the dashboard: a session action in the card's Session actions menu, or a PR action from prFlows.prActions shown as a button on a pull request

concepts.name: report
concepts.definition: A written result handed back to the operator: a Radar investigation's HTML report, the report a PR action sends when it finishes, or the Usage tab's report

concepts.name: review
concepts.definition: An agent's pass over a pull request in the team review lane, drafted for the operator to post, or a GitHub review on the operator's own pull request; the Reviews tab queues both

concepts.name: draft
concepts.definition: A team review or community answer an agent prepared and the operator has not posted yet; on GitHub, a draft pull request, which Reviews parks when it is the operator's own

concepts.name: unit
concepts.definition: A plan step on a whiteboard: a unit element with a status (planned, building, landed) whose wires give the build order

concepts.name: parent
concepts.definition: The session that spawned another through the session tool; its child talks only to it, and closing a child that holds unlanded work is refused until the parent has it pushed or discards it

concepts.name: signal
concepts.definition: A structural fact a session's status is derived from (an agent hook event or an OSC-0 title glyph, never screen content), and the small status badge signal.ts draws from it

concepts.name: comment
concepts.definition: A review comment on a pull request: a GitHub thread the operator can send to a session or dismiss, or a line comment in a team review draft or a plan review

concepts.name: base
concepts.definition: The branch or commit a worktree or pull request builds on: the base branch a session worktree is cut from and rebased onto, or a pull request's base, and the diff base a review compares against

concepts.name: group
concepts.definition: A named section items are sorted into: one of the six Reviews groups (Your turn, Agent working, Queued, Waiting on others, Done, Parked), a project group of sessions in the roster, or an alert group that folds notifications

concepts.name: link
concepts.definition: A connection Glimmervoid keeps and shows between two things: a session linked to its pull request, a linked host reached over an ssh tunnel, or a plan step linked to a board holding it in detail

concepts.name: model
concepts.definition: The model an agent runs, picked per session, per team review or per Arena setup from the agent model catalog Glimmervoid reads from each agent CLI, and the unit Usage breaks spend down by

concepts.name: element
concepts.definition: One drawn thing on a whiteboard (a box, frame, wire or note), counted against a board's element limit; a plan step and a panel are boxes

concepts.name: frame
concepts.definition: A whiteboard element that encloses a set of boxes under a title, optionally marked as a loop

concepts.name: wire
concepts.definition: A whiteboard element drawn as an arrow from one element to another, routed around boxes, whose direction between plan units gives build order; wire contracts are the separate network shapes in shared/contracts

concepts.name: refusal
concepts.definition: Glimmervoid's typed no to an agent's tool call or route request, answered identically on the MCP endpoint and the /agent route so it cannot reveal live session ids

concepts.name: payload
concepts.definition: The body a structural message carries: an agent hook event's JSON posted to the hook route, or a watcher job's kind-specific body parsed against its registered schema in the job inbox

concepts.name: workspace
concepts.definition: A session spanning several repositories: a folder of per-repository worktrees (workspaceRepos) with a generated AGENTS.md map, chosen in Add Session

concepts.name: integration branch
concepts.definition: The branch Glimmervoid cuts every session worktree from and rebases onto: the configured integration branch, or each repository's default branch when unset, read from origin

concepts.name: session id
concepts.definition: An identifier of a session: Glimmervoid's own stable UUID that keys a session everywhere, or the agent CLI's own conversation id that auto-resume captures to resume it

concepts.name: agent
concepts.definition: A coding agent CLI Glimmervoid supervises in a session (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code first-class; Grok, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Copilot CLI and custom CLIs best effort), read through its agent adapter

concepts.name: status
concepts.definition: A session's derived state (starting, running, waiting, idle, complete, failed and the rest), computed from structural signals by the session state machine and shown by the status badge

concepts.name: idle
concepts.definition: The session status for an agent at rest with nothing for the operator to do, reached on a starting session's first output or when the operator dismisses a Complete

concepts.name: complete
concepts.definition: The session status after an agent finishes a turn (task_complete from running, waiting or idle, or a compaction restore); it holds until the operator dismisses it, which the dashboard does on its own 1.5 s after the operator watches it finish, and new output or a prompt leaves it

concepts.name: ready
concepts.definition: A state a thing reaches when it needs the operator next: an agent title showing the idle glyph, a team review draft Ready to post, a plan Ready for review, or a Your turn pull request in the Reviews Ready column, not pulled into Reviewing now

concepts.name: terminal
concepts.definition: A session's live PTY screen rendered with xterm.js in the browser, its Terminal tab and pane in Focus and its Terminal screen on the phone; a headless copy on the server keeps its screen

concepts.name: dashboard
concepts.definition: The browser app Glimmervoid serves on loopback, where the operator watches and steers sessions across its views, on desktop or phone

concepts.name: phone
concepts.definition: The phone layout of the dashboard: a bottom nav with the Board (labelled Focus), Terminal and the phone-only Boards screen, then a More button whose screens hold the remaining views

concepts.name: usage
concepts.definition: The usage tracking lane and its Usage tab: tokens, cost, plan limits and pace per agent and model, read from agent transcripts on this machine

concepts.name: trace
concepts.definition: The Session Trace: a per-session record of hook events, title signals and state transitions the Trace view shows on request, so a status decision can be read after the fact

concepts.name: detection
concepts.definition: Status detection: deriving each session's status from structural signals (agent hooks plus the OSC-0 title fallback), never from screen content

concepts.name: notification
concepts.definition: An alert Glimmervoid raises for a session that needs the operator, through browser notifications and Telegram, with its own lifecycle state machine

concepts.name: factory
concepts.definition: The retired Factory tab and factory lanes that dispatched Coherence tickets to sessions; removed with the knowledge graph and now named only in history

concepts.name: mill
concepts.definition: The retired context mill, which distilled context packs and Long-Term Memory for sessions; named now only in the changelog

concepts.name: headroom
concepts.definition: Free memory under Glimmervoid's memory limit that the memory gate reads before each automatic session start, shown in the debug health panel; also Headroom, a third-party proxy whose integration was removed

concepts.name: issues
concepts.definition: The dashboard's Issues tab, which lists GitHub issues and the step each is at, such as running when a live session works on it

concepts.name: remote
concepts.definition: Remote access: the opt-in remote listener (config remote) that lets a paired device reach the dashboard from another machine

concepts.name: shown
concepts.definition: A file an agent showed the operator with the show tool, which now lands as a card on a whiteboard the session is connected to; the retired Shown button and page that once listed such files are gone (0.52.2)

concepts.name: shell
concepts.definition: A session kind that runs the operator's login shell on the Glimmervoid machine instead of an agent, offered in Add Session

concepts.name: coder
concepts.definition: Coder, the remote development platform whose devboxes can host Glimmervoid, and the Coder activity lane that reports session activity to a Coder workspace

concepts.name: rule
concepts.definition: An operator-written condition and action Glimmervoid applies on its own: a question manager rule that answers a question, or a prFlows rule that acts on a pull request; the brand bible's named design rules are a separate sense

concepts.name: plan
concepts.definition: An agent's plan captured from plan mode (Claude Code ExitPlanMode and its peers) as retained revisions, shown on a session card's plan face for the operator to approve or send feedback on

concepts.name: plan review
concepts.definition: The operator's review of a captured plan on the session card's plan face: reading the open revision, commenting, and choosing Approve or Send feedback

concepts.name: core
concepts.definition: A pure decision module (session/core, server/core or a *-core file) that does no IO, imports no Session and reads no clock, wrapped by a thin IO shell

concepts.name: note
concepts.definition: A whiteboard note pinned to an element with an author and a resolved state; also the git note Glimmervoid attaches to a session commit under refs/notes/glimmervoid

concepts.name: ephemeral
concepts.definition: A lane or child session that runs once in a throwaway folder and is removed when it ends, such as a team review or community run, inside the ephemeral lane write boundaries

concepts.name: task title
concepts.definition: The short title Glimmervoid derives from a session's prompts and the agent's own title, which names the session and feeds the automatic namer

concepts.name: benchmarks
concepts.definition: The opt-in benchmarks lane and its Arena tab (formerly Bench) that run one prompt on several agent setups, each an arm in its own session and worktree, and score them

concepts.name: resume
concepts.definition: Start a session's agent again on its earlier conversation by its agent session id; auto-resume does this at boot for sessions that were live when Glimmervoid stopped

concepts.name: restart
concepts.definition: Start a session's agent process again in place, fresh or resuming its conversation; Restart server replaces the running Glimmervoid server with its current version

concepts.name: doctor
concepts.definition: The glimmervoid doctor command that checks the operator's setup, such as PATH, and says what to fix

concepts.name: golgari
concepts.definition: One of Glimmervoid's built-in dashboard color themes, picked in Settings, Appearance

concepts.name: midnight
concepts.definition: One of Glimmervoid's built-in dashboard color themes, picked in Settings, Appearance

concepts.name: phyrexian
concepts.definition: One of Glimmervoid's built-in dashboard color themes, picked in Settings, Appearance

concepts.name: compleated
concepts.definition: One of Glimmervoid's built-in dashboard color themes, picked in Settings, Appearance

concepts.name: conversation
concepts.definition: An agent's own transcript in a session, kept by the agent CLI under its session id, which resume and restart continue; the retired Conversation view once rendered it as chat

concepts.name: record
concepts.definition: A stored entry Glimmervoid keeps about something: a JSONL line of a session recording (header, data, hook, state, decision, input, resize or footer), a Session Trace record (TraceRecord), a board record that holds its connections, or an agent CLI's own trust record; Coherence journal records and design records under docs/ are records too

concepts.name: history
concepts.definition: Past entries a surface keeps and shows over time: the Usage tab's History rows, a Radar issue's recent occurrence points (one per poll, capped at 24), the session card's History list of earlier manager decisions, and the phone's browser history entries per screen level; in prose, also the project's past as the changelog tells it

concepts.name: dead
concepts.definition: As in dead end: Coherence's reading of a component whose defects keep returning after site fixes (DEAD END in spec --check), quoted in this project's journal practice records; elsewhere ordinary English

concepts.name: arena
concepts.definition: The dashboard view where the operator races one prompt across 2 to 5 agent setups, each in its own worktree from the same commit, and a judge ranks the contestants that changed something

concepts.name: ws
concepts.definition: The ws npm package, the WebSocket library the server runs the control and data WebSockets on; named in dependency notes and changelog entries

concepts.name: tailwindcss
concepts.definition: The tailwindcss npm package, the Tailwind CSS compiler that builds the dashboard stylesheet through its Vite plugin; named in dependency notes and changelog entries

properties.side: The left, right, top or bottom of a box: where a box placed near another sits (near.side) and where a wire leaves or enters a box (fromSide, toSide); elsewhere (server-side, side by side, a side panel) ordinary English

concepts.name: box
concepts.definition: The solid element of a whiteboard: it carries a title, lines, a place (a column, near another box, or at a point), a shape (box, decision or panel) and optionally outputs, media, a width and a step; a plan step is a box with a step and a panel is a box with shape panel; elsewhere (a message box, a note box, a remote box) ordinary English

concepts.name: transitions
concepts.definition: The moves a state machine allows, held in one frozen table per machine (session/core/state-machine.ts, shared/state-transitions.ts) and written only by that machine's owner module
